note: Labels: ACT (new responsibility to confirm), ASK (one question first), WAIT (track an expected reply or dependency), UPDATE (change an existing item), CLOSE (a confirmation closes an existing item), IGNORE (no responsibility). Tracking = any label except IGNORE.
